name: Dan Winter
tagline: I design learning people can use on the job. I still build the courses.
headline: Learning experience design leader
summary: I design courses and simulations for customer and partner teams who have to do complicated work in a product. At Okta I lead learning experience and digital design: the standards, how we use AI in production, and the courses I still build myself. Fifteen years in customer education. Promoted twice in under three years. CEdMA Pinnacle Award for Innovation.
bioParagraphs: I design courses and simulations for people who have to do complicated work in a product — customers, partners, and the teams that sell and support them.
At Okta I lead learning experience and digital design for customer education. I was promoted twice in under three years. That chapter of the work earned a CEdMA Pinnacle Award for Innovation.
I set the bar for how we build and how we use AI when we build, and I stay in the work. I still ship the courses myself. I've been doing this for fifteen years.
